description: Search the asset library: over a thousand ready-made base recipes (furniture, street furniture, storage and industrial props, nature, buildings, vehicles, props), each a model spec with parameters that builds a clean, lint-checked .glb. With nothing: an overview per category and family. With `query` (English or Dutch words, e.g. 'oak chair', 'rode bank', 'pine tree') and/or filters: matching assets, one line each. With `id` (e.g. furniture/dining-chair-oak-ladder): what it is, its parameters, materials and parts; with `spec: true` the full spec JSON to copy, change and pass to godot_model_build as `spec`. Build one as is with godot_model_build `kind: <id>` and `params`. Start here before writing a spec from scratch. Read-only.

archetype.description: only assets of this archetype or below it, e.g. prop.chair

category.description: only this category: furniture, street, storage, nature, buildings, vehicles or props

id.description: an asset id to show, e.g. furniture/dining-chair-oak-ladder

query.description: words to search for, English or Dutch

spec.description: with `id`: return the full spec JSON

name: godot_model_library
title: Asset library: ready-made base recipes
